description:
Tradition Spice Company brings premium herbs, spices and seasonings directly to customers.  Our products are bottled in small batches for maximum freshness.  

We select spices from top suppliers that adhere to strict quality standards, sustainable farming practices, and soil to table freshness. 

Our mission is for healthy food to taste great and enjoy well flavored meals together.  

This affiliate program is designed for you and for fun.  Not only to earn while promoting but to do so by enjoying our products.  You'll get to select up to 3 products to promote and we encourage you to do so by trying out the spices, herbs or seasonings and sharing your creations with your audience.  

Posting the links to the showcased products and encouraging your audience to try for themselves is, of course, how you will earn.  You can link to as many of our products as makes sense to your audience.  We offer kits and bundles that can bring a higher cart price, so feel free to focus on those if you like.

You'll earn a 30% commission when a new customer orders.  Then up to 15% on subsequent orders for up to 2 years with that customer.  Encouraging your audience to continue to use our spices will help your commissions - and provide your audience another delicious meal!

Ways to promote with food is straight forward.  Use the spices in a recipe you either cook on camera or show the end results of something you cooked.  In either model, highlighting how the spice enhanced the flavor of the meal is important since the audience cannot smell or taste - but you can!

If you post a recipe, include the affiliate link to the spices you used.

Encourage your audience to check out all the flavors we offer at Tradition Spice Company at traditionspice.com.  

Most importantly, as you should know...  Be your authentic self.  Don't over sell.  Just let your audience know what you used in your recipe.

Finally, If you are interested in partnering with Tradition Spice Company beyond affiliate links - such as sponsorships, co-marketing - feel free to reach out at service@traditionspice.com.

Have a fantastic day!
payout_period: 1st of the Month after commission is validated and past refund/chargeback periods.
